subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: poison delivery method
fact: Midnight tears poison is ingested and activates at midnight, with color change upon contact with saliva.
source_quote: The dust stays pale ochre. What darkens it is saliva.

subject: sapphire spell function
fact: The sapphire summoning spell retrieves a hidden object to the caster's hand, regardless of location.
source_quote: You can put it someplace, you can throw it into a river or whatever. Nobody will find it, and then when you need it back, boom.

subject: High Tower entrance
fact: The High Tower is the entrance to all super-magical artifacts, always watched, entry always visible.
source_quote: The tower is watched. Always. People stand at it whether the key is in someone's pocket or not.

subject: key transfer
fact: Kalan transferred the second High Tower key to someone who is not himself, and now holds no key.
source_quote: I have given it now to someone who is not me.

subject: locket key storage
fact: The key was carried in a locket worn around the neck, now missing.
source_quote: The key was in the locket. The locket was around the keeper's neck. The locket was gone.

subject: murderer's method
fact: The murderer is a magic user who can circumvent arcane and mundane locks with talking magic.
source_quote: Magic that could talk any lock open, arcane or iron, the very highest order of that art.

subject: murder timing
fact: The victim died at midnight after ingesting midnight tears poison, likely via licking a poisoned page.
source_quote: He died at roughly midnight. His fingers were black, his lips were black.

subject: Flora Theca location
fact: The Flora Theca is a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis within the Great Library, dedicated to plants and herbs.
source_quote: The Flora Theca, a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis, inside the Great Library, dedicated to plants, herbs, and other flora.

subject: midnight tears poison origin
fact: Midnight tears is a highly toxic pale ochre dust made from Feywild pollen, lethal unless neutralized by specific Feywild sap.
source_quote: A highly toxic pale ochre dust, made from the pollen of a plant usually found only in the Feywild.

subject: false identity
fact: Someone impersonated Sylvira Savikas the night of the murder.
source_quote: Is he aware that someone was pretending to be Sylvira Savikas the night of the murder?

subject: Hearth interrogation venue
fact: The suspect Daral Yashenti chose the Hearth as the venue for interrogation, asserting control over the setting.
source_quote: Daral was not coming to us. We were to go to the Hearth.

subject: investigator collaboration
fact: Kalan proposed a private sync-up meeting with five streams to merge findings and resolve contradictions.
source_quote: A meeting to examine everything one by one, the four of us and him, five streams, merge it all in a few hours.

subject: key carry definition
fact: Worn objects are not considered 'carried' for the purpose of the sapphire summoning spell.
source_quote: It doesn't, as it turned out. Which reframed the whole use.
